ITEM 1 | Shredded orange carrot strands, thin matchstick-like cut about 5-8 cm long, bright orange with slight sheen, piled loosely in the center-right of the bowl | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark red kidney-shaped beans, glossy and slightly wrinkled skin, roughly 1 cm each, clustered in a mound at the lower-left of the bowl, moist surface | 70
ITEM 3 | Diced red bell pepper pieces, roughly 1 cm cubes, bright red with glossy skin, scattered among the carrot strands and beans | 15
ITEM 4 | Diced green bell pepper pieces, roughly 1 cm cubes, bright green with pale edges, scattered on the left side of the carrot pile | 10
ITEM 5 | Thin white onion rings or slices, translucent-white, about 4-6 cm long, lying across the carrot pile, flat and crisp-looking | 8
